headline: Monza HM delivered — 1:36:32 at target effort, job done
summary: Strong execution: 21.18km in ~1:36:32 (moving time), average HR 167, well inside the 1:37-1:40 target window and under the 172 cap. The 21x4:34@166bpm interval pattern shows pacing was dead-on for the prescribed 4:38-4:40/km Z4 block, and HR stayed controlled rather than drifting into the 175 stop-rule territory — HRR of 13bpm post-effort and feel of 1/RPE 8 both point to a near-maximal but well-managed race rather than a blowup. No pain or ITB signal logged. The 41m cooldown jog afterward (122bpm avg) ticks the box for the ~2h30 on-feet target and compliance landed at 78%, fine for a training race with warm-up/cooldown built in. This counts as this week's long run + threshold session exactly as designed — nothing more is owed on the quality side for a few days.
flags: icu training load (136+27=163) undercounts a near-threshold half marathon effort by the usual 20-25% for sustained high-intensity work — treat the RPE 8/feel 1 and the clean HR execution as the real signal, not the load number.
Sleep last night was short (5h44m, score 73) and this morning's HRV sits at 55 vs a 63-78 recent range with RHR 49 — watch recovery over the next 48h given the race stress stacking on that.
suggestedChange: Consider trimming or converting Tue's prescribed Wk4 session to pure easy/shakeout given today's race depth and the short sleep — confirm with Alberto before locking Tuesday's load.
